scope: Close the concrete initialization regressions introduced by moving ordinary hosts loading to the logging-ready Init stage. This evidence contains two targeted startup experiments, not the complete-family qualification.

source_basis.dnsmasq.c:1098: Initial poll_resolv completes before entering the main loop.
source_basis.dnsmasq.c:1177: The first helper queue turn can freeze one pre-EVENT_INIT lease callback.
source_basis.dnsmasq.c:1264,1319,1334: The event pipe (including EVENT_INIT) is handled before DHCP packet handling and helper_write.
source_basis.dnsmasq.c:1575,1839: EVENT_INIT calls clear_cache_and_reload; ordinary hosts are reloaded before DHCP configuration/name refresh.
source_basis.dhcp.c:1092: host_from_dns permits an FQDN only when its domain matches get_domain; these fixtures use domain=test.

repairs.change: After initial ordinary hosts publication, invoke existing provider.hosts_changed when no hostsdir work remains. The existing final hostsdir-publication path handles nonempty directories. Gate provider callback take/freeze on completed file initialization while continuing helper initialization/output/pipe/reaping.
repairs.reason: The first F07 implementation only refreshed DHCP names from the hostsdir completion path; ordinary-only startup left restored lease names unchanged. Repeated owner turns during resolver input could also snapshot or send later helper events before hosts publication.

repairs.change: Gate DHCP packet work and the helper provider wakeup branch on the same files_initializing condition.
repairs.reason: The held-FIFO control actually received an early Rust ACK using the client name. The wakeup gate prevents a retained callback from making the owner busy-poll while its file prerequisite is blocked.

normalization.helper_events: Every argv element and every environment variable is compared in sequence. Only capture monotonic_ns is excluded; infinite leases avoid expiry/remaining-time normalization. DNSMASQ_DATA_MISSING and DNSMASQ_OLD_HOSTNAME remain in the comparison.
normalization.lease_file: The probe compares sorted lease lines to avoid ordering-only noise. Raw order is preserved here; final C/R file order also agrees.
normalization.DHCP: The FIFO controller sends one REQUEST with fixed MAC/XID, observes for 250 ms while holding the writer open, then explicitly releases the input. It does not retransmit. Post-release decoded fields must agree, and the C result must be ACK with authoritative-one.

retained_fixture_attempt.reason: The first FIFO producer closed without replacing the FIFO. C inotify then opened it again and waited for a new writer, so that FIFO arm did not produce a completed callback observation. Its normal and large-resolver arms retain the same real regression, but this attempt is not called a completed three-case run.
retained_fixture_attempt.correction: Before closing the held writer, atomically replace the pathname with an ordinary file containing the same resolver line. Subsequent inotify-driven opens terminate while the original FIFO hold still gives a controlled pre-Init observation window.

limitations: The fixtures restore exactly two infinite leases and use ordinary addn-hosts, domain=test, -k and a controlled helper environment. They are not an exhaustive matrix of all lease-init/script-user/input combinations.
The full helper environment is retained safely because daemon launch supplies only PATH, LC_ALL and TZ; no session environment or credentials are inherited.

Explicit image-musl invocation makes libc.so the C /proc/exe entry point. The target C ELF is separately bound by its exact-image SHA; the recorded /proc/exe hash is not mislabeled as the target ELF hash.
Complete affected helper/helper-shutdown/lease-recovery families and other regression families are recorded separately.
